correctness.rationale: The published CDF gives the corrected minus-sign relation by exact algebra. The left side has derivative \(-\tau^2(2+\tau+\tau x^2/2)e^{-\tau x}<0\), so its range is exactly \((0,(1+\tau)^2]\). The printed plus-sign right side lies strictly outside that range, whereas the corrected right side lies strictly inside it and therefore has one unique root. Independent numerical replay reproduces the source's displayed quartiles from the corrected relation.
